protocol_name: Semi-permeable capsule (SPC) workflow: Capsule filter, lysis, reverse transcription and wash chip

events.narration: IR step 15 (aggregate_filter): transfer: FEED inlet_1 (capsules_suspension) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped. Filter the capsules through a 100 um strainer to remove aggregates.

IR step 16 (reaction_trap): exchange to lysis_buffer: FEED reagent_line_in (lysis_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Exchange the buffer for lysis buffer and incubate.
IR step 16 (reaction_trap): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 22 C for 10 min (placeholder time). Exchange the buffer for lysis buffer and incubate.

IR step 17 (reaction_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED reagent_line_in (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 3 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules in wash buffer.

IR step 18 (reaction_trap): exchange to rt_mix: FEED reagent_line_in (rt_mix) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Exchange into reverse transcription mix and incubate.
IR step 18 (reaction_trap): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 42 C for 1 h (placeholder time). Exchange into reverse transcription mix and incubate.

IR step 19 (reaction_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED reagent_line_in (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT reaction_trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 2 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules.

IR step 19 (reaction_trap): collect the capsules: FEED reagent_line_in (buffer push), VENT outlet_1 into a tube labelled 'chip3_filter_lysis_rt_wash: capsules after step 19, for chip4_shell_release_bead_capture_wash_elution inlet_1'. Every other port capped.
